dependency_basis: Existing COW and R1/R2 interfaces are ready. Identity/resources/correctness follow each stage under section 5; this batch does not implement or claim future R3/R5 candidate integration.

deliverables.R4.1: Move owned mutation payloads through existing per-page coalescing; count requested owners, coalesced source pages and emitted page images; map write amplification and bounded/global exceptions.
deliverables.R4.2: Necessary publication fault, pinned snapshot, reclamation/backpressure and mature-file checks without changing durability.
deliverables.R6.1: Charge bounded observation metadata, protect direct batches/borrowed images/output lifetimes and existing sort/DISTINCT spill.
deliverables.R6.2: Query-local PROFILE physical-work counters and honest EXPLAIN access/adapter descriptions with units/scopes; preserve result and side-effect semantics.
deliverables.R6.3: Resource refusal/cancellation/physical-readonly fault checks, observation responsibility split, platform execution scope and future-format obligations.

admission: Foundation/correctness/observability evidence only. R4.3 and all R7 performance gates remain unaccepted.
